capabilities: Chat with vault notes using graph RAG with cited sources
Automatically start, stop, and monitor a local LightRAG server
Ingest notes in many file formats and re-index a watched folder on save
Explore the knowledge graph in 2D or 3D views
Expose the graph to MCP clients such as Claude Desktop
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a text-composition or writing assistant; it is a chat interface over a knowledge graph of your vault.
extras: Full documentation lives in a separate wiki; mobile support works only against a remote LightRAG server over HTTP. The README includes a privacy section and explains why the Obsidian scanner flags certain capabilities (filesystem writes, child_process, vault enumeration).
intentEvidence: Forked from Smart Composer by glowingjade
problem: Keyword and vector search in Obsidian return fragmented matches and miss multi-hop relationships between entities across notes.

relations.evidence: Forked from Smart Composer by glowingjade
Use Ollama for a fully offline setup, or any hosted provider you prefer

requires.name: API key for a hosted AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, etc.)

summary: Graph RAG chat plugin that runs a local LightRAG server, indexes vault notes into a knowledge graph, and answers questions with citations.
